pose: Landscape master shot focusing on an environmental backdrop under bright, direct midday sunlight with high-key exposure. High-angle perspective overlooking a vast, lush conifer forest valley with a prominent winding river snaking through the center. The deep green and dark slate grey tree canopy features warm, natural highlights and soft-edged cinematic shadows that emphasize the 3D volume of the rolling hills. A vibrant blue sky replaces the sunset, maintaining a clear atmospheric perspective with a slight hazy glow along the distant, soft mountain horizon to create deep volumetric space.
